mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(publish_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishDate, DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as expireDate, is_active as isActive, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM notices WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = true
SELECT * FROM notices WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(publish_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishDate, DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as expireDate, is_active as isActive, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM notices WHERE is_active = true AND is_important = true ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(publish_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishDate, DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as expireDate, is_active as isActive, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM notices WHERE is_active = true AND is_popup = true AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date > NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(publish_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishDate, DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as expireDate, is_active as isActive, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM notices WHERE is_active = true AND publish_date <= NOW() AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date > NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC
